summary: Saturator: tape, tube, transistor, diode and wavefolder models with bias, tone filters, auto gain and oversampling. Use it for warmth and grit on tracks, glue on buses, or as a distortion effect.
use_for: Add warmth, grit or fold-back harmonics with tape, tube, transistor, diode and folder models.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.how: Chooses the saturation model: Tape, Tube, Transistor, Diode or Fold.
parameters.sound: Tape is soft and warm, Tube is rich and full, Transistor is firmer, Diode is edgy and Fold is bright and metallic.

parameters.name: Drive
parameters.how: Raises the level going into the saturation by 0 to 36 dB.
parameters.sound: More drive adds harmonics, going from a subtle warmth to heavy distortion.

parameters.name: Bias
parameters.description: Shifts the curve off centre: even harmonics
parameters.how: Shifts the signal off centre before the saturation.
parameters.sound: Pushing it away from the middle adds even harmonics, which sound fuller and more asymmetric.

parameters.name: Character
parameters.description: Tape: emphasis. Tube: sag. Transistor: hardness. Diode: asymmetry. Fold: folds
parameters.how: Sets the model's special trait: tape emphasis, tube sag, transistor hardness, diode asymmetry or fold amount.
parameters.sound: Higher values make each model more pronounced and more obviously coloured.

parameters.name: Low cut
parameters.how: Filters the low frequencies, from 10 Hz to 1 kHz, out of the signal before it is saturated.
parameters.sound: Bass stops overloading the saturation, so the result is tighter and less muddy.

parameters.name: Tone
parameters.description: Tilt after the saturation: darker or brighter
parameters.how: Tilts the tone after the saturation, darker towards the left and brighter towards the right.
parameters.sound: Turn it down to soften harsh distortion; turn it up for more sparkle.

parameters.name: High cut
parameters.how: Removes frequencies above 1 to 22 kHz after the saturation.
parameters.sound: Lower values tame fizz and harshness, making the drive darker and smoother.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.how: Sets the final level in dB, from -24 to +24.
parameters.sound: It makes the sound louder or quieter without changing the amount of distortion.

parameters.name: Auto gain
parameters.description: Holds the level steady as the drive changes
parameters.how: Keeps the output level steady as Drive changes.
parameters.sound: You hear the character change rather than a simple volume increase.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet (the dry signal is delayed to match)
parameters.how: Blends the saturated signal with the dry signal, delayed to match.
parameters.sound: Lower values keep the original punch and add the saturation as a subtle layer.

parameters.name: Quality
parameters.sound: Higher settings keep high-frequency distortion clean and free of aliasing, but use more processing power.
